remarks: Text layer is clean and matches the image. Set A's 5.296E10 MW entry appears to be an OCR/parse artifact of "5.296610 MW" re-bound to the wrong property and then rationalized with an invented quote and a fabricated caveat. Both sets lose the "square" qualifier in the Region 2 torque relationship value field (only present in the quote), and both omit the stated purposes of Regions 1½ and 2½ (lower speed limit; limiting tip speed/noise at rated power) and the Region 2½ induction-machine torque slope.
